title: About us
subtitle: Technical problem solvers for manufacturing
intro: De Machinedokters believe in local production and in a strong manufacturing industry. Since we were founded in 2018 we have specialised in optimising production processes, modernising ageing machines and building special-purpose machines for companies in a range of sectors.
quote: "If you can dream it, we can make it run."
story:
At De Machinedokters everything revolves around making things run better. We are technical problem solvers who improve existing machines and processes with smart, durable modifications. No thick reports or standard solutions, but practical work that delivers straight away.

Since 2018 we have been helping factories produce more efficiently and building special-purpose machines. That experience taught us that many machines do not need replacing. They just need the right treatment. We are in the factory, among the people and the machines. That is where we see what is really going on and what can be improved.

De Machinedokters was founded in the Netherlands. We now also help manufacturing companies in Örebro, Värmland and Västmanland counties in Sweden.

Freek moved to Grythyttan in Bergslagen in 2025. From there we are building De Machinedokters in Sweden, so that manufacturers here get the same help as our customers in the Netherlands: a local contact, with the whole team behind him.

values.title: Customer-focused
values.text: We listen, think along and deliver solutions that fit what the customer needs. We prefer to work together for the long term.

values.title: Innovative
values.text: With smart and often unexpected solutions we get more out of existing machines.

values.title: Reliable
values.text: A deal is a deal. We communicate clearly and deliver quality you can rely on.
